title: Human-approved primary-source reconciliation after resume
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 2 request to resume OpenFS work. Reconcile representative life-science, materials, and weather AI model records against public original papers, official repositories, current model cards, licences, and measured hardware conditions. Publish only bounded provisional findings, preserve unresolved measurement and reproduction gaps, and distinguish paper-scale models from downloadable checkpoints. Keep Consensus incomplete. Do not merge a pull request or deploy GitHub Pages.
